work.label: People & work
work.caption: Placements describe employment context. Tasks share the employee/account context and run against a concrete form template; they are not children of a placement.

forms.label: Forms & versions
forms.caption: A lineage identifies a form across versions. A version has a concrete task template; page and field templates describe its contents.

access.label: Account & access
access.caption: Accounts belong to organizations. Organization membership and group membership are separate records; group access rules remain opaque data in this runtime.

configuration.label: Policy & scope
configuration.caption: Policies connect to form lineages. Custom properties carry permission-scope metadata, while automations and authorization inference rules record account configuration.
